resources.string: A silent, ongoing notification shown while gambling sites are being blocked. Android requires it.
Gambling sites and apps are blocked.
Blocking is locked on until your commitment period ends.
%,d known gambling domains are blocked on this phone — in every app and every browser, even when Tigil is closed.
Tap the shield to block gambling sites across this whole phone. Setup takes one tap and one Android permission.

Lock protection on for a set period. While the lock is active, Tigil cannot be switched off — not from this screen, not from the notification, not from Quick Settings. The urge to disable a blocker passes; the lock is there to outlast it.
Stops apps and browsers from using their own secure DNS to get around the block. Leave this on unless something stops working.
Your phone is set to send every lookup to a Private DNS server, which goes around Tigil completely. Nothing is being blocked right now. Open Network settings and set Private DNS to Off or Automatic.

Tigil blocks gambling sites by name, which stops them loading in any app or browser on this phone. It cannot stop a site reached by raw IP address, another VPN installed on top of it, a different phone, or a computer on another network. Anyone who wants to get around it can. This is a wall against impulse, not against determination — and that is usually the wall that matters.
If gambling is costing you money, sleep, or people you love, please talk to someone. In the Philippines: NCMH Crisis Hotline 1553 (toll-free, nationwide) or 0966-351-4518.
